criteria.calibration: pooled top-label ECE (10 bins) at most 0.05
criteria.constraints: upper end of the family-clustered interval of the unsafe-share difference to the train-selected fixed ratio at most +1.0 percentage point
criteria.gain_over_train_fixed: family bootstrap and family t interval (47 df) of the utility difference both exclude zero
criteria.gain_over_tuned_rule: the same two intervals for the difference to rule_best both exclude zero
